scatter_tensor_mesh: scatter a list of tensors to a device mesh dimension using mesh_scatter
broadcast_tensor_mesh: broadcast a tensor to all ranks in a device mesh dimension using mesh_broadcast
redistribute_cost: calculate the communication cost of redistributing a DTensorSpec from current to target placement
compute_allgather_cost: compute the estimated allgather communication cost for a given number of bytes on a mesh dimension
estimate_redistribute_cost: estimate the total redistribute cost between two DTensorSpec placements across mesh dimensions
